title: A Small Walk Before Work · 原创示范材料
transcript: Last year I started taking a short walk before work. At first, I wanted to get some exercise, but the real benefit was having time to clear my head. On busy mornings, I put my phone away and pay attention to the street around me. Some days I only walk for ten minutes; that is enough to ease into the day. When a difficult task is waiting, I break it down while I walk. By the time I sit down, I have a rough plan. The habit did not transform my life overnight. It simply gave me a small pocket of quiet. That makes it easier to follow through on one important thing, even when the rest of the day feels messy.
